description: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of four different Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) configurations as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale with data ranging from 1 to 10, displaying numeric tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains a solid black line without markers representing "DPR w/o query," which remains constant at a value of approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis from 1 to 10. A solid red line with circle markers represents "DPR w/ corpus expansion." It starts at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 35.15, rises to about 35.55 at x=2, and gradually increases to a peak of approximately 35.8 at x=7 before ending at roughly 35.75 at x=10. A solid green line with upward-pointing triangle markers denotes "DPR w/ document expansion." This line starts at x=1 with a y-value of approximately 34.75, maintains a relatively steady trend with a slight peak of about 34.9 at x=6, and ends at approximately 34.85 at x=10. Finally, a solid blue line with star markers represents "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion." It begins at x=1 with a y-value of roughly 34.75, rises to a peak of about 35.0 at x=2, drops to 34.7 at x=3, rises to a second peak of 35.0 at x=5, and then steadily declines to end at approximately 34.35 at x=10.
